reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding — the rendered text is identical to the originals, so no invalid or directionally wrong edit exists.

The cited paragraphs contain no non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use restriction binding our party: Section 9.2 is a transaction-protective anti-transfer/anti-lien covenant over property already sold, Section 5.7 is a standard SPE no-division covenant, and Section 9.9 binds Cellco as Sponsor (counterparty side) and only restricts sale/transfer/financing/hedging of the retained Residual Interest as required by Regulation RR.

None of the cited covenants limits what businesses we may operate or what products we may buy or build, so the preferred position (no non-compete on Customer) is met; the deterministic check confirming no open-ended compete restriction is consistent.
Rationale accurately characterizes each cited provision and the negative-search evidence; retaining this as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue is appropriate.
